function.name: science_history_get_invention

message.content:
The theory of relativity was developed by **Albert Einstein**.  
- **Special Theory of Relativity** – published in **1905** (the “Annus Mirabilis” papers).  
- **General Theory of Relativity** – published in **1915** (after a decade of work).
